description: This PHP script handles the saving of a Purchase Order in the SugarCRM-based application. It processes user input, updates the purchase order record, manages stock updates upon shipment receipt, logs actions, and redirects the user to the detailed view or previous interface.

classes.name: PurchaseOrder
classes.description: A class representing the purchase order entity, used for creating and updating purchase order records.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the current purchase order object to the database.
